- What we need from you to size pricing: expected monthly token volume, typical avg tokens per request (prompt + response), and peak TPS (instantaneous peak requests/sec).

- Expected monthly token volume (tokens/month)

2) Note if Dedicated capacity makes sense for guaranteed p99 latency at your peak
3) Put together a formal quote / sample invoice for procurement.

Next steps: if you can reply with the rough numbers by tomorrow, I’ll aim to get a draft quote back within 48 hours. Also happy to set a 30-min follow-up if that helps.

Thanks Marissa — good call. Here are the rough numbers we can share today (happy to refine after internal check):

- Expected monthly token volume: ~120,000,000 tokens/month (120M) — this is our baseline for Q4; could grow ~20% next year.
- Average tokens per request: ~150 tokens (combined prompt + response).
- Peak TPS: ~20 requests/sec (we see short bursts up to ~30 TPS for 3-5 min during peak traffic).
- Target budget: we're aiming for a hosted-cost target around $1.5k–$3k/month initially. If we can get to ~$10–$15 per 1M tokens that would be ideal for our model mix.

Notes: our traffic is spiky; 20 TPS sustained for a few minutes is typical. We don’t need enterprise SLA on day one but want predictable cost and a clear upgrade path to Dedicated if latency becomes an issue.

If you could show cost examples at $10/1M, $12/1M, and $15/1M with the numbers above, that would help our finance team. Happy to jump on a quick walkthrough if that makes it easier.

Perfect — thanks for the numbers, Alex. That’s exactly what we need. Below are quick ballpark cost examples for Hosted API and a note on where Dedicated becomes worth considering.

Ballpark Hosted API examples (rough):
- At $10 per 1M tokens: 120M tokens -> $1,200/month
- At $12 per 1M tokens: 120M tokens -> $1,440/month
- At $15 per 1M tokens: 120M tokens -> $1,800/month

Notes on unit economics and peak TPS:
- Your peak bursts to ~30 TPS for a few minutes are fine on Hosted API — our autoscaling handles short spikes. For consistent high p99 latency guarantees at peak (e.g., <250ms at p99) we often recommend Dedicated capacity.
- If your average tokens/request stays ~150 and monthly tokens stay ~120M, the hosted examples above should map cleanly to your $1.5k–$3k budget range (you’re inside it at $12–$15/1M).
- We can often offer committed/volume pricing for multi-month/annual commits that lower the $/1M token rate; if you can share a 6–12 month forecast we can model a reserved discount.

Attachments: I’m attaching hosted_api_pricing_ballpark.pdf (explains model tiers and volume discounts) and usage_estimate.xlsx (I filled in your numbers to show monthly cost by tier). I’ve also updated the mutual_action_plan.docx to capture next steps.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll prepare a short formal quote (hosted examples + an alternate Dedicated sizing note) and send to you and procurement.
2) Optional: 30-min pricing walkthrough this week to walk finance through the examples.
3) If you want a predictable committed price, share a 6-month forecast and we’ll model a reserved discount and draft terms.

Sean (cc) — can you prepare a Dedicated sizing note if Alex decides they want committed capacity?

Thanks — talk soon.
